rationale.consistency: Cobra/flag wiring and api field additions follow surrounding style, but stub.go imports testing into a production package, omitempty on decode-only structs, and an always-true KeepExistingBody option are off-convention.
rationale.edge_cases: Covers dup files via os.SameFile, empty/'-' values, size/type/dir/empty checks, code spans/fences, reference defs and escapes; but deliberately writes a body after a partial upload failure, contrary to 'if one upload fails nothing is written'.
rationale.scope: Adds unrequested behaviour (video reference-image refusal, degrade-to-link with \! escaping), dead code (isSingleImage, UploadStub, _ = astLinks, unused lineInRanges end param), and a partial-write policy the requirement excludes.
rationale.readability: references.go is ~790 lines of hand-rolled bracket/reference scanning layered on goldmark with duplicated counting blocks; client.go repeats the same uploadError literal seven times.
rationale.robustness: No obvious panics, files and bodies are closed, bounds are guarded; sequential uploads use context.Background and stat-time ContentLength, and the partial-success path can leave a half-attached body.
rationale.maintainability: attachToBody/newXUploader copy-pasted into four packages, hasDeferredEdits duplicates hasDeferredFlags, newAttachableMarkdown duplicates attachAssetsToMarkdown; the custom markdown scanner is fragile to keep in step with goldmark.
